name: Fossify Launcher
tagline: A simple, ad-free launcher for your phone
description:
Fossify Launcher is a practical, no-frills launcher that makes it easy to get to your favorite apps. It's part of the Fossify family of open source Android apps, all built to be simple, ad-free, and privacy-respecting.

If you like a clean home screen without trackers or clutter, this is a solid, actively maintained choice.
